subject.title: [security] Diagnostic exact-secret redaction misses env-only provider API keys

question: Should diagnostic exact-secret redaction use a provider-owned credential-source registry/hook for env-only providers, or should this be a targeted hardcoded env-var hotfix?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but the permanent fix touches Crabbox's credential-redaction boundary and the provider-neutral architecture guidance in AGENTS.md.

options.title: Add provider-owned credential inventory
options.body: Register each provider's trusted runtime credential sources with the diagnostic redaction collector and cover current env-only providers plus regression tests.

options.title: Patch the hardcoded env list
options.body: Add the affected env var names directly to configuredDiagnosticSecrets as a narrower hotfix, accepting future drift risk.

options.title: Defer to generic regex redaction
options.body: Leave exact-redaction unchanged and rely on pattern redaction, accepting that unusual diagnostic formats remain outside the documented guarantee.

recommendation.title: Add provider-owned credential inventory
recommendation.body: Register each provider's trusted runtime credential sources with the diagnostic redaction collector and cover current env-only providers plus regression tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The current collector, provider config comments, and central redaction PR history point to steipete as the clearest owner for the credential-redaction boundary decision.
